lead.headline: Nothing moved overnight: Monangai is in a boot, both Vikings receivers are still undecided, McLaurin is still questionable
lead.deck: No Saturday report had been published by 09:30 Eastern. Nothing to do today; three names to read on Sunday's inactive lists.
lead.body: Start with the bad news about your own players, which is Friday's bad news unchanged. Kyle Monangai is out for Green Bay with turf toe, in a walking boot and seeing a specialist; Ben Johnson's words are 'we'll see how long that injury sidelines him'. Justin Jefferson and Jordan Addison are both questionable, and the Saturday decision Kevin O'Connell promised had not been published when this was written; one report has it being made on Sunday morning. Jefferson says playing is 'definitely something that I want to do'. Terry McLaurin is questionable after a single limited practice, with Stefon Diggs ruled out beside him. Isaiah Likely is cleared. You are 0–4 and trail 31.5 to nothing on Bucky Irving's Thursday night; ESPN gives you 45%. Two corrections to Friday's edition: Romeo Doubs shares Mack Hollins's work with three other Patriots receivers and is not their lead, and Philadelphia's own site expects Will Shipley to be the primary back in London. Neither changes a move. Tomorrow's edition is written before the 09:30 inactive lists, so the two cards below are yours to fire.

players.caption: Monangai: out, in a boot, no timetable

doFirst.headline: Nothing today; two checks at 09:30 on Sunday
doFirst.deck: McLaurin goes into the flex if he is active. Jefferson's fallback is Addison, then McLaurin.
doFirst.note: No move today. This afternoon: Minnesota's decision on Jefferson and Addison, if it comes, and Buffalo's final report. Sunday 09:30: if McLaurin is active, start him over Gordon; if Jefferson is inactive, Addison takes his slot, and McLaurin if Addison is out too.

cards.headline: Jefferson in, Addison then McLaurin behind him
cards.reason: Limited all three days and questionable. No decision had been published by Saturday morning and it may come on Sunday; the fallback, Addison, is questionable himself.
rows: Terry McLaurin, 12.8, if he is active

cards.headline: McLaurin into the flex if he is active
cards.reason: One limited practice on Friday, his first since 2 Oct, and nothing new since; Diggs is out. 1.9 over Gordon: a coin flip that goes to the projection.
rows: Ollie Gordon II, 10.9, already in the flex
The inactive list, Sunday 09:30; both kick off at 11:00

roster.deck: As set you project 122.1 and the projection lineup is 124.0: the one change is McLaurin over Gordon in the flex, a 1.9 coin flip to be made on Sunday if McLaurin is active. Nothing moved overnight.
